label: Reception hall revelation

purpose.value: The truth is laid out in full — gifts from all ten realms, the peace-feast table, the banner, the murals of the guardians helping one another — and the hero studies it and delivers his verdict: "A false history. Their deception is even greater than I feared."

emotionalProgression.note: The player's awe: the hall waited five thousand years for a friend.
The hero's verdict lands, calm and utterly wrong.

notes: sceneType note: the enum has no revelation/discovery type; "monologue" is the closest longer-form fit — the hall itself is the de facto speaker (banner, gifts, murals) and the hero's verdict is the scene's one spoken line, so char_protagonist is the sole participant in his default state. NO realm characters are present: the hall is empty; it waited five thousand years for its first visitor. Content: gifts from all ten realms, the long peace-feast table, the faded banner reading "WELCOME, FRIEND BEYOND THE GATE", and murals of the guardians helping one another — the Colossus building bridges, the Tide-Man ending a flood, the Griffin guiding travelers, the Dryad restoring burned land, the Reliquary King preserving the names of the dead. forbiddenRevelations is intentionally EMPTY: this is the one scene where the whole truth is on the table — and the hero still reads it as a false history.
